WHAT'S NEW
4.2
BATTLE BALLS 4.2
Veer, boss music, a meaner Champion, and two keys per action.
NEW LEGENDARY: VEER

A passive ability: every ball you hit veers off on a wild curve. Whip your camera round as you hit and it bends even harder, the way you turned. Bots get fooled into swinging early.

THE CHAMPION FIGHTS BACK

Boss Rally has its own music that builds with every phase. The Broken Champion now attacks from the start and much more often in his last phase — watch the floor.

QUALITY OF LIFE

Every control can have a second key (Settings → Controls). Passive abilities say PASSIVE on their button. The ball held by Opi's Wrath and Infinity now trails after you. Dev2's effects are bigger.

BOSS RALLY

Team up, 1 to 4 of you, against The Broken Champion. One heart each, one ball: five parries break his guard and the fifth ball hits him. Every guard break revives a downed teammate. His returns start to curve in phase 2, and in phase 3 he fights back — watch the floor. Coins for every quarter of his health you take, plus a victory bonus. Find it in Casual, or pick it as a room's mode.

FRIENDS, PARTIES & MESSAGES

Hit FRIENDS in the lobby. You have a tag (like NAME#1234) to share. Add friends, see who's online or in a match, message them, invite them straight into your lobby, or make a party of up to 6 and bring everyone in at once. Notifications pop up top right.

TUTORIAL

A one-minute tutorial that teaches the block, what a miss costs, and your ability. Find it in How to Play whenever you want it.

FAIRER & SMOOTHER

Ranked and online rewards are now confirmed by the server (and never lost if your connection drops). Popups no longer let you move or block behind them. The lobby draws about half as much, and Low quality is much lighter on iPads. On phones the lobby buttons fold into a MENU.

PATCH: APEX, PB FETUS & BALANCE

Apex now reaches the new #1 the moment their win puts them there, and rides on the back. PB Fetus is now ULTRA, with a much bigger swing. Ricky's .9 fires a finale on its last beat. Divine Judgment: 28s cooldown and a harder slam, and a parry now kills the slam's speed. Dylan's Warts buffs are much stronger. Ascended no longer drops when you swing.

PATCH: 3D PREVIEW & MORE

Every item now shows in your inventory, locked if you don't have it. Tap VIEW IN 3D on any blade to spin it round. Apex has wings, a molten core, a floating crown and a crown that drops on every strike. Ricky's .9 and PB Fetus now strike once per swing. Jordan Nuh Tribute is nerfed: 32s cooldown, a smaller slam, and no banked parry. Pass items now just say HALLOWEEN.

SEASON 1 & THE GOD RANK

Ranked starts over: everyone's RP resets to 0 for Season 1, but everything you earned is yours to keep (last season's rewards are now called Season 0). The climb is harder, with new rewards at every rank and a different weapon type at each step. Past MEAT sits GOD at 15,000 RP, earned only in 1v1 against real players from the GOD queue. It gives Ascended, Divine Right and Divine Judgment.

APEX

One weapon, one owner: whoever is #1 on the leaderboard. A black-and-gold lance with a floating crystal guard. Lose the top spot and it goes to the new #1. There is only one.

THREE NEW MYTHICS

Ricky's .9: every block is a gunshot. Grey's 14 Inches: a shockwave that speeds the ball up. Dylan's Warts: a gamble ability. All three are on Gnorman's shelf for launch week.

HALLOWEEN

The lobby has gone Halloween, with a moon, graves and bats. There's a new casual mode, Trick or Treat: candy baskets, tricks, and a second pumpkin at the witching hour. The Black Cat skin is on Gnorman's shelf for 850 yen, and the Wendigo Katana has its own shrine for one week only.

RODRIGA

An ogre witch has moved in behind spawn. Any match has a tiny chance to drop a Rodriga token. Take it to her shack for her item of the month. October's is PB Fetus. Please stop asking where it came from.

DAILY REWARDS

Log in each day in October for coins, yen and free spins. Days 10, 20 and 30 give a free LEGENDARY+ spin.

PUBLIC LOBBIES & MAPS

Hosted lobbies are now public, so anyone can join from the list (flip Private to keep yours invite-only). The host picks the map too.

THE SERVER RUNS EVERY MATCH

Multiplayer no longer runs on one player's game. The server now runs the whole match: the ball, the bots, every block, every ability and who wins. Nobody gets an edge from hosting, a laggy host can't ruin the room, and a match result can't be faked. Whoever has been in the room longest still picks the mode and presses start.

THE LOBBY

A target range to warm up on, jumping, a proper hitbox on the centrepiece and Gnorman's shack, and you spawn further forward.

REDONE

Bert Sampsoon is a true classic now: the scarlet speedster. The DEV skin is redone as a void knight to match its blade. Divine Right and its swing are reworked. PB Fetus is bigger and whirls on its cord, Ricky's .9 twirls and double-taps, and Apex gets its own golden strike and a crown over the #1's head. Grey's 14 Inches is fixed: it rolls from in front of you and knocks people back instead of flooding the screen. Dylan's Warts has no cooldown: spin again the moment it stops. The starter gear got a glow-up too: Rookie has a proper kit, Shadow a deep hood, Neon is lit trim head to toe and Static has a TV for a head. Trainer, Steel Katana, Crimson Fang and Gold Executioner are all rebuilt.

FIXES & BALANCE

Endless is retired (owners are refunded). Bots can now block Opi's Wrath and start moving before the countdown ends. Jordan is toned down in ranked 1v1. Nobody can be hit while Ramen's Uncut Hair is reeling them in. The block and ability buttons sit at the bottom of the screen on phones. The server address is gone from the multiplayer menu. The battle pass is a longer grind. Weapons are held more naturally: spears stand at your side, the pistol sits at low ready, and hip blades wear like a sheathed sword.

HOW TO PLAY

Red means you

The ball is plain grey while it hunts somebody else. The moment it locks onto you it turns red, you glow red, and the screen edges flare.

It always finds you

There is no dodging — the ball homes until it connects. Your only answer is the block.

Press to block

A press raises a block for half a second; if the ball touches you while it is up, it goes back. Catch it in the first 0.08 seconds for a perfect: double coins and a harder return. A block that catches nothing locks you out for half a second.

You aim your return

The ball leaves the way you are facing and curves onto whoever it picks, so aim wide to bring it in from the side.

Shift Lock

Locks your body to the camera with a dot marking your aim. A and D strafe instead of turning, so you can circle someone while your return stays on target.

One hit and you are out

Win matches to climb the ranked path and unlock its exclusive blades and skins.
